title: Enterprise access request routing & prioritization playbook (RBAC / SSO / SCIM / org policies)
creator: Lena Park
description: Goal: Create a practical triage and routing playbook for incoming enterprise admin & identity requests (RBAC changes, SSO/SAML integrations, SCIM provisioning, org-level policy requests). This ticket captures intake fields, priority signals, routing rules, stakeholder owners, and acceptance criteria so PM/Support/SE/Security consistently route and prioritize work without ad-hoc escalation. Scope excludes individual bug fixes and immediate incident responses; focuses on intake-to-squad-routing for non-urgent enterprise product work.
acceptance_criteria: Intake form template added to support portal with required fields (customer org size, SSO vendor, SCIM desired, SLA requirement, PII level)
Routing rules documented: rules for auto-assigning to Solution Engineering (SE) vs Platform PM vs Security when specific signals present
Prioritization rubric published (customer tier, legal/regulatory need, security risk, feature reuse value) with weighting example
Runbook for handling 'SSO vendor unsupported' cases including temporary workaround options and expected timelines
Dashboard tile in Console PM view shows queue depth and average time-to-triage for admin requests
decisions: Use a single unified intake form (Support + Sales + CSM) rather than separate ticket types to reduce confusion
Prioritize security-sensitive requests (SCIM enabling for audit-required customers) above feature parity requests for non-compliant vendors
Default owner for RBAC policy change requests is Platform PM + Eng squad assigned by dependency matrix; SE consulted for complex org mappings
